d: The survivors of Michael Myer's killing spree recover from the chaos, only to be faced with a new terror.
Two couples traveling across Texas end up as prisoners of a sadistic backwater family of serial killers.
The Firefly family are being hunted by a sheriff who's actions are almost as bloody as those of his prey.
After barely surviving prison, the demented Firefly clan go on the run, unleashing a whole new wave of mayhem.
